<!-- This is at the top of the list regardless of how small it looks. A cockpit
     that misreports the agent it is watching is worse than no cockpit.

     Examples of what belongs here:
       - a status that does not match your config.yaml
       - "the gateway is running" when nothing is listening on the port
       - a profile saved, with the agent behaving as if it were never written
       - a count, a total or a spend figure that does not match reality
       - a preset reported as active after you changed the file by hand -->
